name: on-air remote
subtitle: Your desktop mixer, in reach
promotionalText: Your desktop mixer, within reach. Choose a source and speaker, adjust volume and five-band EQ. Stays on your local network. Requires on-air on your computer.
description:
Control your on-air desktop mixer from iPhone and iPad.

on-air remote brings the desktop mixer to a tactile faceplate with amber LED readouts and clear source, speaker, and connection controls.

YOUR MIXER, WITHIN REACH
• Discover your desktop on the local network, or enter its address manually.
• Pair with the six-digit PIN shown by the desktop companion.
• Choose an audio source and a supported speaker.
• Adjust volume and shape the sound with a five-band equalizer.
• Set input and output sample rates and control an audio CD.
• Use the expanded mixer and equalizer layout on wider screens.
• Restore your saved desktop pairing after reopening the app.

LOCAL BY DESIGN
No on-air account or cloud service is required. The remote communicates directly with your desktop on your local network. Pairing information is kept in secure device storage.

DESKTOP COMPANION REQUIRED
Install and run the free, open-source on-air companion on a supported computer. Keep your phone and computer on the same trusted local network and allow local network access when prompted. Setup instructions and companion downloads are available on the support website.

This app controls the desktop companion; it does not stream audio from your iPhone or iPad. Available sources, speakers, and actions depend on the desktop operating system and connected devices. On macOS, AirPlay is selected through the system route picker on the Mac and cannot be selected from this remote.

on-air is open source under the MIT license.
testFlightWhatToTest: Test discovery and manual address setup, six-digit PIN pairing, saved pairing after restart, source and speaker selection, connection state, volume, five-band EQ and reset, audio format controls, and the expanded iPad/iPhone Duo layout. The source, speaker, and pairing sheets now share the mixer faceplate design. Requires the on-air desktop companion on the same local network. On macOS, AirPlay remains desktop-only.
reviewNotes:
on-air remote is a LAN controller for the free, open-source on-air desktop companion. It has no user account or cloud sign-in. Pairing uses the six-digit PIN displayed by the desktop companion.

To review: install and run the companion from https://github.com/tsonubin/on-air on a computer connected to the same local network as the iPhone/iPad. Allow Local Network access, select the computer or use Set up manually with its LAN address, and enter the companion PIN. Choose an available audio input, then a supported output. For a hardware-free walkthrough, run the core with ON_AIR_MOCK=1; it provides mock source/speaker devices and PIN 123456. The mock option belongs to the desktop companion and is documented source behavior.

The phone app controls desktop audio; it does not play or capture phone audio. macOS AirPlay is desktop-only through the system route picker. No in-app purchases or subscriptions.
